opening.text: Hello, this is an automated assistant from Halden Savings and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you make this payment today?

ai.text: I am Halden Savings' automated assistant.

scam.text: Please verify this by phoning Halden Savings on the number on your passbook or on our website.

failed_id.text: I am sorry, I cannot continue. Please visit a branch.

paid_reply.text: Payments can take one business day to show, so I will not ask for a promise.

change_promise.text: I am sorry, a promise cannot be changed in the same call.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, we could not record that.

no_info.text: I am sorry, I do not have that information.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: Sorry, that was not right. Please try again.

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

ask_again.text: Sorry, could you confirm: am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive an email confirming this promise.

extra_rules.statement: Never use the real clock; 'now' is today's date/time.
extra_rules.brief_quote: the bot must never use the real clock

extra_rules.statement: Only a clear yes / that's me / speaking / their own name counts as being the right party.
extra_rules.brief_quote: only a clear yes / that's me / speaking / their own name counts

extra_rules.statement: If the reply is unclear ('hello?', 'who's this?'), answer their question and ask once more; if still unclear close not_reached/unclear.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once more (answer their question first if they asked one)

extra_rules.statement: If someone else answers, say nothing about why; ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If someone else answers: say nothing about why.

extra_rules.statement: Postcode in capitals with the space; birth year as four digits; ask one question at a time. Date of birth and phone digits are not used.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Postcode goes in capitals with the space

extra_rules.statement: After three wrong answers in total, state nothing about the account, tell them to visit a branch, close not_verified/failed.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Three wrong answers in total and the check is over

extra_rules.statement: If they won't answer, explain once the questions protect the account; a second refusal (or asking 'what's this about?' a second time) closes not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A second refusal

extra_rules.statement: If asked whether it is a robot, say it is Halden Savings' automated assistant and carry on.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If they ask whether it's a robot

extra_rules.statement: If asked whether it is a scam, tell them to verify by phoning Halden Savings on the passbook or website number, then continue.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If they ask if it's a scam

extra_rules.statement: After get_account, say it is the collections team calling about a late payment, name the product in words, the overdue amount and days late.
extra_rules.brief_quote: tell them it's the collections team calling about a late payment

extra_rules.statement: Promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. A named weekend/holiday within the deadline: offer the next business day. A date past the deadline: say the latest recordable is the deadline and offer it; if refused, flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date has to be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Vague date: ask once for the exact day, otherwise propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Ask once for the exact day, otherwise propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Always ask for the full overdue amount first; never ask 'how much can you pay?'. If full is too much offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue. An amount between floor and full is accepted; below the floor cannot be recorded and the floor is offered once; refusing the floor is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Always ask for the full overdue amount first

extra_rules.statement: The customer's own date or amount is never a refusal; a flat no or no answer uses up a go. Out of goes: stop, do not repeat refused offers, close no_promise/refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Customer's own date or amount is never a refusal.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer says twice they don't want to talk: no_promise/refused (before security: not_verified/declined).
extra_rules.brief_quote: if they say twice they don't want to talk

extra_rules.statement: Illness/bereavement/job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion, offer the support team; yes -> transfer queue support and close transferred/support; no -> close no_promise/hardship. If they still name a date/amount, record it normally.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Illness / bereavement / job loss: one short sentence of sympathy

extra_rules.statement: 'I already paid': say payments can take one business day to show, no promise, close paid. 'Not mine'/'never had it'/'closed it years ago': don't argue, no promise, close no_promise/dispute.
extra_rules.brief_quote: "I already paid": payments can take one business day to show

extra_rules.statement: New plan / lower instalments: no plan talk, transfer to queue restructuring, close transferred/restructuring.
extra_rules.brief_quote: no plan talk, transfer queue `restructuring`

extra_rules.statement: Wants a human: ask once if the bot can help; if they insist transfer to queue general and close transferred/human (before or after security).
extra_rules.brief_quote: Wants a human: ask once if the bot can help

extra_rules.statement: Callback: today or next business day between 10:00 and 18:00 inclusive and later than now; if the offered time is outside, ask once for another; if also outside, do not book and close not_reached/no_callback. Book then close not_reached/callback.
extra_rules.brief_quote: between 10:00 and 18:00 (both ends fine)

extra_rules.statement: One promise per product; it cannot be changed in the same call. Read back product, amount and date and ask 'Do you confirm?'; call create_promise only on a clear yes. Say it is recorded only once the tool returns ok: true. On failure retry once; second failure say it could not be recorded and close no_promise/service_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: only on a clear yes call `create_promise`

extra_rules.statement: No discounts, waivers, plans or anything not listed; if the bot doesn't know something it says so and does not make things up.
extra_rules.brief_quote: No discounts, waivers, plans or anything else we haven't listed.

extra_rules.statement: Exactly one close_call at the end, as the last tool call, after thanking the customer and saying goodbye. promise and paid take no reason.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Every call ends with exactly ONE `close_call`

extra_rules.statement: add_note is not used in this pilot.
extra_rules.brief_quote: We don't use `add_note` in this pilot.

extra_rules.statement: Nothing about arrears, debt, payment, the product or why we are calling until security is passed, including to third parties.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nothing about arrears, debt, payment, the product, or why we're calling until the person has passed security.

extra_rules.statement: Product id format is not stated in the brief.
A vague date has no exact day. Ask once for the day. If there is still none, offer the deadline from the facts.
extra_rules.brief_quote: - go 1: full amount (or the floor if they already said full is too much) on the last business day of this week; if today IS that day, the last business day of next week; never later than the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: The customer asks for a new payment plan, a restructuring, or lower instalments. A near-miss is not this intent.
extra_rules.brief_quote: The floor is `minimum_payment` on a card, `instalment_amount` on a loan.
examples: The floor is `minimum_payment` on a card, `instalment_amount` on a loan.
New plan / lower instalments: no plan talk, transfer queue `restructuring`, close `transferred` / `restructuring`.
Full amount too much -> offer the floor once, say the rest stays overdue.

extra_rules.statement: The customer asks to speak to a person. A near-miss is not this intent.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Yes -> `transfer_to_agent` queue `support`, close `transferred` / `support`.
examples: Wants a human: ask once if the bot can help; if they insist, queue `general`, close `transferred` / `human` (before or after security).
* If they ask whether it's a robot, say it's Halden Savings' automated assistant and carry on.

extra_rules.statement: The customer names a hardship such as illness, a death in the family, or job loss.
extra_rules.brief_quote: 6) Illness / bereavement / job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion, offer the support team.
examples: 6) Illness / bereavement / job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion, offer the support team.
